h2: Range Rover Velar Ingenium Diesel Timing Chain Issues?||
description: We replace timing chains, tensioners and injector seals as standard on every Ingenium diesel rebuild where worn or damaged. This is the same well-documented pattern found across the Evoque and Discovery Sport, which share the same engine family.

callout.title: A Well-Documented Issue
callout.body: Ingenium AJ200D injector seal leaks and timing chain wear are widely documented across Land Rover specialist forums and official TSBs.

heroHook.title: Include In Hero Hook:
heroHook.body: Yes — both verified: Ingenium AJ200D widely documented with multiple TSBs; M156 pre-2012 established Land Rover specialist pattern.

features.title: New Timing Chains
features.body: Replaced as standard (where worn or damaged)

features.title: Peace Of Mind
features.body: No hidden extras — just a stronger, longer-lasting engine
